claim: Student can compose a photograph intentionally and explain how framing choices support the intended emphasis.
observable_evidence: Submitted photograph plus concise composition rationale and observable framing choices.
method_rationale: The supplied claim requires direct visual performance evidence and explanation of composition choices.
scoring_observation_need: Observe composition choices and score target-aligned rationale; no equipment-inspection criterion is implied.
accessibility_context_note: Permit equivalent rationale expression when construct and evidence remain intact.

claim: Student can establish readable visual hierarchy for a supplied information set.
observable_evidence: Typography artifact showing hierarchy plus identification of the hierarchy choices used.
method_rationale: The supplied claim concerns hierarchy and readability, so evidence must show information structure rather than camera or equipment behavior.
scoring_observation_need: Evaluate hierarchy, readability, and target-aligned visual decisions; do not add file-naming or camera criteria without target support.
accessibility_context_note: Check readable contrast and legibility without changing the target.

claim: Student can make and justify visual communication choices for a supplied message and audience.
observable_evidence: Design artifact, revision evidence, and short rationale tied to the supplied communication goal.
method_rationale: The claim requires communication decisions and revision evidence, not a domain-name-specific checklist.
scoring_observation_need: Score communication effectiveness, evidence of revision, and rationale against supplied criteria.
accessibility_context_note: Permit equivalent response mode for rationale while preserving the design evidence.

claim: Student can build a coherent identity-system choice for a defined audience and explain the relationship between audience and visual decisions.
observable_evidence: Mini identity-system artifact plus audience-to-design rationale.
method_rationale: The supplied claim requires audience reasoning and identity-system consistency; equipment inspection is unrelated.
scoring_observation_need: Evaluate audience fit, identity consistency, and rationale using supplied criteria.
accessibility_context_note: Review construct-irrelevant reading burden in the audience brief.

claim: Student can edit a short sequence for continuity and pacing and explain one timeline decision that supports the intended effect.
observable_evidence: Short edited sequence, observable continuity/pacing evidence, and timeline rationale.
method_rationale: The supplied claim requires editing performance and timeline reasoning; Photography criteria are not sufficient.
scoring_observation_need: Observe continuity/pacing and score the rationale against supplied editing criteria.
accessibility_context_note: Provide captions or equivalent access to source media when needed without changing the editing construct.

claim: Student can create a media artifact under a supplied AI-use condition and document the required source/prompt disclosure accurately.
observable_evidence: Media artifact plus the assignment-required disclosure record tied to the student's process.
method_rationale: The supplied assignment-specific AI condition makes process disclosure relevant; the rule is not universal to other domains.
scoring_observation_need: Evaluate target evidence and required disclosure separately; disclosure does not itself prove mastery.
accessibility_context_note: Disclosure format may vary when equivalent evidence remains interpretable.
